description: Adds a sending domain (one per workspace) and returns the exact DNS records to create, plus registrar_hint (cloudflare, godaddy, namecheap, route53, vercel or unknown). Uses no quota. Safe to call again: an existing domain returns its current records. If you have a DNS provider tool for that registrar connected, offer to add the records yourself; otherwise show them as a table and point the person to their DNS settings or the Hollerpost dashboard. Then call domain_verify. Requires API key scope: account.

domain.description: A sending domain or subdomain, for example mail.example.com. No https://, no path.

name: domain_add
title: Add sending domain
